projects.title: The Invisible Engine & Digital Immune System
projects.tech: LangChain, n8n, CrewAI, Lakera Guard, Python, Pinecone
projects.raw_details: Architected an 'Adaptive Resilience' system that treats cyber threats like biological viruses. Implemented an 'Adversarial Feedback Loop' where a Red Team agent attacks the model, and a 'Sentinel' (BERT classifier) detects anomalies. Features a self-healing mechanism that automatically updates system prompts ('Cognitive Patches') to block specific semantic attack vectors in real-time.

projects.title: Agentic AI Workflow Orchestrator
projects.tech: n8n, OpenAI (Function Calling), LangChain, Python, Pydantic
projects.raw_details: Designed a 'Loop-on-Error' architecture to solve the 'Hallucination of Action' problem. If the AI generates invalid JSON, the error is fed back into the model to self-correct. Uses Chain-of-Thought prompting to decompose vague requests into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of tasks. Implemented 'Human-on-the-Loop' checkpoints for high-risk actions.

projects.title: Autonomous Email Lead Manager (SDR Agent)
projects.tech: n8n, Gmail API (IMAP Idle), GPT-4o Mini, HubSpot API
projects.raw_details: Built a 'Watch-Analyze-Act' pipeline that transforms unstructured emails into structured CRM data. Uses IMAP Idle for real-time triggering (no polling). Implemented regex pre-filtering to save API costs and an entity extraction layer to normalize phone numbers to E.164 format before upserting to HubSpot.

projects.title: Thesis: Synthetic Cloud Removal from Satellite Images
projects.raw_details: Developed a Progressive Multi-scale Attention Autoencoder to reconstruct cloud-free optical satellite images. Generated 10,000 synthetic training images using Perlin noise. Outperformed state-of-the-art models (STGAN, CTGAN) in PSNR and SSIM metrics.
